comparison: Perfect agreement on methodology (C96-C100). Both OpenEval and all three peer reviewers validate the computational approach as appropriate, well-performed, and state-of-the-art with extensive conformational sampling.

Strong agreement on MD simulation quality and N343 glycan stabilization effects (C16, C46-C48, C50). OpenEval finds extensive MD data demonstrates conformational changes; peer reviewers unanimously affirm the evidence is convincing and methodology validated.

Agreement on evolutionary interpretation (C87-C89) but with different confidence levels. OpenEval rates as UNCERTAIN due to speculation about evolutionary potential; peer reviewers explicitly endorse the conclusion that SARS-CoV-2 evolved to make N343 'structurally dispensable' and support implications for immune evasion.

Agreement on BA.2.86 N354 glycan findings (C85-C86, C90). OpenEval finds structural characterization well-documented; peer reviewers implicitly accept this as part of the broader evolutionary narrative about alternative glycosylation strategies.

Strong agreement on variant-specific responses (C52-C53, C56). OpenEval supports findings for Alpha/Beta variants; peer reviewers explicitly validate that variants without structure-reinforcing substitutions behave like ancestral strain, while those with stabilizing mutations (Delta, Omicron) show different responses.

Agreement on Delta's structural stability mechanism (C67-C74, particularly C72, C74). OpenEval finds Delta resistance to N343 glycan removal well-characterized; peer reviewers explicitly note L452R and similar substitutions prevent conformational changes when glycan is removed.

Agreement on Omicron compensatory mechanisms (C77-C82, particularly C81-C82). OpenEval supports structural mechanism showing hydrophobic compensation; peer reviewers validate that Omicron variants contain substitutions with analogous stabilizing effects to Delta's L452R.

Strong agreement on Delta ganglioside binding validation (C17, C75-C76). OpenEval finds experimental validation consistent with MD predictions; peer reviewers explicitly note Delta maintains binding when glycan is removed, unlike ancestral strain, confirming structural predictions.

Agreement on ganglioside binding site validation (C57-C62). OpenEval finds experimental ESI-MS data compelling validation of predicted binding site; peer reviewers affirm experimental assessment validates structural predictions and note binding variations are of strong interest.

Agreement on ancestral strain ganglioside binding (C18, C63-C66). OpenEval supports ESI-MS measurements and structural inference; peer reviewers validate that glycan removal abrogated binding for ancestral strain as predicted by simulations.

Agreement on Omicron weak ganglioside binding (C19, C83-C84). OpenEval finds measurements supported with mechanistic explanation somewhat speculative; peer reviewers acknowledge complexity with multiple contributing factors but accept experimental measurements as valid.

Agreement on Beta variant E484K effects (C65) and binding site structure (C58, C63-C66). OpenEval finds structural inference reasonable; peer reviewers implicitly accept predicted binding site by noting experimental results matched structural predictions across variants.

Partial agreement on ganglioside binding implications (C91-C92). OpenEval supports C91 but notes C92 is speculative about future mutations; peer reviewers accept the binding site prediction as validated by experimental consistency across variants.

Strong agreement on broader implications (C93-C95, particularly C95). OpenEval finds contextualization appropriate; peer reviewers strongly endorse the epistasis implications, stating the glycosylation-stability interplay may substantially expand predicted mutational repertoire.

OpenEval evaluates background/context claims (C1-C9) as well-supported by established literature. No corresponding peer review evaluation found, as reviewers focused on novel findings rather than background material.

OpenEval evaluates structural characterization claims (C10-C15) as supported by literature and Figure 1b data. No corresponding peer review evaluation found; reviewers did not separately assess background structural characterization.

OpenEval evaluates N343 glycan bridging conformation claims (C20-C25) as well-documented through computational analysis. No corresponding peer review evaluation found; this structural detail was not explicitly discussed by reviewers.

OpenEval evaluates RBM structural and functional characterization (C26-C37) as supported by citations and MD data. No corresponding peer review evaluation found; reviewers did not separately assess RBM characterization details.
